title: 第0001章 绝脉少年雨夜惊雷第0002章 白鲜皮现毒心初显
content_zh:
八荒大陆，东荒，青炎域。
时值隆冬，青石板铺就的林家内门通道上，早已积了一层薄薄的寒霜。
寒气顺着鞋底侵蚀而入，对于常人而言尚且刺骨，对于此刻蜷缩在通道角落的一名少年来说，更是如同万根钢针，狠狠扎进他的骨髓深处。
少年约莫十六七岁年纪，衣衫褴褛，单薄的中衣早已被污泥与血渍浸透，紧紧贴在身上，勾勒出嶙峋的骨架。
他名叫林药尘，曾是青炎林家这一代备受瞩目的旁系子弟，如今，却成了整个家族乃至青炎城最大的笑柄——一个天生绝脉，无法修炼半点真气的“废柴”。
更可怕的是，三个月前，他在家族后山采药时，莫名遭人毒手，身中一种名为“腐骨散”的奇毒。
此毒不入五脏六腑，专蚀筋骨经脉，让他本就脆弱的身体雪上加霜，每日都要承受毒发时的蚀骨之痛，如同有无数蚁虫在啃噬他的骨髓。
“咳……咳咳……”
一阵剧烈的咳嗽声从少年喉咙里挤出，他猛地弓起身子，脸色惨白如纸，额头上渗出豆大的冷汗，牙齿咬得咯咯作响，试图以此压制那股从脚底板直冲天灵盖的剧痛。
通道内偶尔有衣着光鲜的林家子弟经过，他们或是三五成群，谈笑风生，或是行色匆匆，奔赴各自的修炼场所。
没有一个人愿意在正眼瞧一下这个蜷缩在角落的“废物”，即便目光扫过，也充满了毫不掩饰的鄙夷、厌恶，甚至是快意。
“啧，这不是我们林家那位‘天才’林药尘吗？怎么又瘫在这儿了？是毒发了还是饿晕了？”
一个略带讥讽的年轻声音响起。
林药尘艰难地抬起沉重的眼皮，视线模糊中，看到两个穿着锦缎华服、腰佩长剑的青年走了过来。
这两人是林家内门弟子，也是林药尘曾经的同辈，说话之人名叫林厉，是林家二长老的儿子，向来以欺凌林药尘为乐。
“厉哥，您就别取笑他了。”
旁边那个叫林虎的青年嗤笑一声，眼神轻蔑，“他现在就是一条丧家之犬，离死不远了。
我看啊，干脆把他扔出家族算了，留着他，简直是我们林家的耻辱。”
林药尘的指甲深深掐进掌心，鲜血顺着指缝溢出，但他却感觉不到丝毫疼痛。
比起身体上的折磨，这些话语像是一把把钝刀，反复切割着他的尊严。

他曾也有过梦想，梦想像其他子弟一样，踏上武道，光耀门楣。可现实是，他连站起来的力气都没有。
“林药尘，”林厉蹲下身子，用手中的折扇挑起林药尘的下巴，强迫他看着自己，脸上带着恶意的笑容，“听说今天家主召集族老议事，好像是要正式将你逐出家族呢。
也是，养条狗还得喂口粮，养个废物，还中毒将死，留着何用？你那未婚妻苏清雪小姐那边，估计也早就忘了有你这么号人了吧？”
苏清雪！
这个名字如同烧红的烙铁，狠狠烫在林药尘的心上。那是他青梅竹马、也是他曾经拼命想要追赶的身影。
北荒冰原域苏家的千金，先天冰灵体天才，半年前被接到林家暂住，当时两人虽因身份差距日渐疏远，但也未曾想今日……如今，恐怕真的已是云泥之别了。
一股腥甜涌上喉咙，林药尘强行咽下，眼眶通红，却倔强地不肯流出一滴泪。他不能死，至少不能这样窝囊地死！
“滚……”林药尘从牙缝里挤出一个字，声音沙哑干涩。
“嘿，还挺硬气？”林厉冷笑一声，猛地站起身，一脚踹在林药尘的肩膀上，“废物，给你脸了是吧？我告诉你，就算家族不赶你走，你也活不过这个冬天！识相的，自己爬到后山去死，省得脏了我们林家的地！”
林虎也上前，狠狠踢了几脚，直到林药尘蜷缩得更紧，如同风中残烛，两人才骂骂咧咧地扬长而去。
通道再次恢复冷清，只剩下林药尘一人，在寒风中瑟瑟发抖。
剧痛、寒冷、饥饿、屈辱……种种感觉如同潮水般将他淹没。
他的意识开始模糊，视线逐渐黑暗，耳边似乎嗡嗡作响，仿佛来自地狱的召唤。
“难道……我林药尘，真的要这样结束了吗……”绝望如同毒蛇，缠绕住他的心脏。
content_en:
The Eight Wilderness Continent, the Eastern Wilderness, and the Qingyan Territory.
It was the middle of winter, and a thin layer of frost had already accumulated on the inner doorway of Lin's house paved with bluestone slabs.
The cold air eroded along the soles of the shoes, which was biting to the bone for ordinary people. For the young man huddled in the corner of the passage, it was like thousands of steel needles, piercing deep into his bone marrow.
The boy was about sixteen or seventeen years old, and his clothes were in rags. His thin middle coat had been soaked with mud and blood, and it clung tightly to his body, outlining his rugged frame.
His name is Lin Yaochen, and he was once a high-profile descendant of the Qingyan Lin family. Now, he has become the biggest laughing stock of the entire family and even Qingyan City - a "waste" who was born with no pulse and cannot cultivate any true energy.
What's even more frightening is that three months ago, when he was collecting medicine in the back of his family, he was poisoned for no apparent reason and was poisoned by a strange poison called "Rotten Bone Powder".
This poison does not penetrate into the internal organs, but only eats away at the muscles, bones, and meridians, making his already fragile body even worse. He has to bear the bone-eroding pain when the poison attacks every day, as if countless ants are gnawing at his bone marrow.
"Cough... cough cough..."
A violent cough was squeezed out of the young man's throat. He arched his body suddenly, his face was as pale as paper, and a large amount of cold sweat oozed from his forehead. His teeth were gritted, trying to suppress the severe pain that shot from the soles of his feet to the sky.
Occasionally, well-dressed children of the Lin family passed by in the passage. They were either in small groups, chatting and laughing, or in a hurry, rushing to their respective training places.
No one wanted to take a direct look at this "trash" huddled in the corner. Even if they glanced at him, they were full of unabashed contempt, disgust, and even pleasure.
"Tsk, isn't this the 'genius' Lin Yaochen from our Lin family? Why is he paralyzed here again? Is he poisoned or fainted from hunger?"
A slightly sarcastic young voice sounded.
Lin Yaochen raised his heavy eyelids with difficulty. In his blurred vision, he saw two young men wearing brocade clothes and carrying long swords walking over.
These two people were inner disciples of the Lin family and former peers of Lin Yaochen. The person speaking was named Lin Li, the son of the second elder of the Lin family. He had always enjoyed bullying Lin Yaochen.
"Brother Li, please stop teasing him."
The young man named Lin Hu next to him sneered, with contempt in his eyes, "He is a lost dog now, and he is not far from death.
I think we should just throw him out of the family. Keeping him would be a shame to our Lin family. "
Lin Yaochen's nails dug deeply into his palms, and blood overflowed from his fingers, but he felt no pain at all.
Compared to physical torture, these words were like blunt knives, repeatedly cutting into his dignity.
He once had a dream, a dream to embark on the martial arts and shine like other disciples. But the reality is that he doesn't even have the strength to stand up.
"Lin Yaochen," Lin Li knelt down and lifted Lin Yaochen's chin with the folding fan in his hand, forcing him to look at him with a malicious smile on his face, "I heard that today the head of the family convened the clan elders for a discussion, and it seems that he wants to formally expel you from the family.
Also, if you raise a dog, you have to feed it with rations, you have to raise a waste, and it will be poisoned to death, so what's the use of keeping it? Your fiancée, Miss Su Qingxue, has probably forgotten that you are such a famous person, right? "
Su Qingxue!
This name was like a red-hot iron, scorching Lin Yaochen's heart. That was his childhood sweetheart, and the figure he once desperately wanted to catch up with.
The daughter of the Su family in the Northern Wilderness Icefield, a genius with an innate ice spirit body, was taken to the Lin family to live temporarily half a year ago. Although the two of them had become increasingly estranged due to the gap in status, they never thought about today... Now, I am afraid that they are really separated from each other.
A sweet taste surged up into his throat, and Lin Yaochen forced himself to swallow it. His eyes were red, but he stubbornly refused to shed a single tear. He couldn't die, at least he couldn't die like this!
"Go away..." Lin Yaochen squeezed out one word from between his teeth, his voiceHoarse and dry.
"Hey, you're still tough?" Lin Li sneered, stood up suddenly, and kicked Lin Yaochen on the shoulder, "Trash, I'm giving you face, right? I tell you, even if the family doesn't drive you away, you won't survive this winter! If you are wise, climb up to the back mountain and die yourself, so as not to dirty the land of our Lin family!"
Lin Hu also stepped forward and kicked him hard several times until Lin Yaochen curled up even tighter, like a candle in the wind, and then the two of them walked away cursing.
The passage became deserted again, leaving only Lin Yaochen alone, shivering in the cold wind.
Severe pain, cold, hunger, humiliation...all kinds of feelings overwhelmed him like a tide.
His consciousness began to blur, his vision gradually darkened, and his ears seemed to be buzzing, like a call from hell.
"Could it be that...I, Lin Yaochen, am really going to end like this..." Despair was like a poisonous snake, wrapping around his heart.
